statement.p: The force on an object is \vec F = -22\,\mathit{\vec j}. For the vector \vec v = -3\,\mathit{\vec i}-\,\mathit{\vec j}, find:
(a) The component of \vec F parallel to \vec v:
(b) The component of \vec F perpendicular to \vec v:
The work, W, done by force \vec F through displacement \vec v:

static.solution:
\vec v. Since ||\vec v|| = \sqrt{(-3)^2+(-1)^2} = \sqrt{10}, the unit vector in direction of \vec v is \vec u = \vec v/\sqrt{10}. Then
(a) \vec F_{||} = (\vec F \cdot \vec u) \vec u = (22/\sqrt{10}) \vec u = \frac{-66}{10} \vec i + \frac{-22}{10} \vec j.
(b) We have \vec F_{\perp} = \vec F - \vec F_{||} = (-22\,\mathit{\vec j}) - (\frac{-66}{10} \vec i + \frac{-22}{10} \vec j) \approx 6.6\,\mathit{\vec i}-19.8\,\mathit{\vec j}.
(c) Since work is the dot product of the force and displacement vectors, we have W = \vec F \cdot \vec v = 22.
